label: Steady
description: Poisson, mean 6 a week. The case the bootstrap assumes.

label: Lumpy
description: Mean 6, but weeks vary about as much as the mean (CV ≈ 1): batch releases, zero weeks.

label: Speeding up
description: Mean rises steadily from 3 to 9 a week over the history, then holds at 9.

label: Team change
description: Mean 4 a week, then 8 a week from halfway through the history onward.

label: Good and bad spells
description: Runs of good weeks (9) and bad weeks (3); each week has an 85% chance of staying in the same spell.

label: One odd week
description: Steady at 6, except one week where 30 tickets were closed at once.
